dialogue.speaker: inner
dialogue.text: The shop is quiet. Too quiet. Tito Yuyu is always here by now.

dialogue.speaker: inner
dialogue.text: His glasses are still on the counter. His jacket is still on the hook. He never leaves without them.

hint.speaker: inner
hint.text: Exit the house and look around.

dialogue.speaker: alya
dialogue.text: Oh! You must be {player}. Tito Yuyu talks about you all the time.

dialogue.speaker: alya
dialogue.text: I'm Alya. I… I help Tito sort scrap into restorable artifacts.

dialogue.speaker: inner
dialogue.text: She looks worried. Like she's been waiting for a while.

dialogue.speaker: alya
dialogue.text: Tito didn't come home last night. He's never done that before.

dialogue.speaker: alya
dialogue.text: But the shop needs to keep running. If you find scrap in the yard, I can sort it for you.

dialogue.speaker: alya
dialogue.text: Just bring me whatever you find and I'll turn it into something worth restoring.

hint.speaker: alya
hint.text: Find scrap in the yard and give it to me.

dialogue.speaker: alya
dialogue.text: Good find! I sorted your scrap into two pieces.

dialogue.speaker: alya
dialogue.text: Keep only one for restoring — storage is tight. The other goes back to the recycler.

dialogue.speaker: alya
dialogue.text: Pick the one that looks more promising. Don't worry, you'll get plenty more chances to find treasures.

hint.speaker: alya
hint.text: Keep one artifact, recycle the other.

dialogue.speaker: alya
dialogue.text: Nice choice! Head inside and start restoring. The shop needs you now.

dialogue.speaker: alya
dialogue.text: I'll be here if you need more scrap sorted. And… if you hear anything about Tito, please tell me.

hint.speaker: alya
hint.text: Head inside the shop to start restoring.
